200.description: Every registered site, ordered by code.

schema.description: One keyset page of Site (REST API guideline 3).

items.description: A physical facility/building — the root of the location hierarchy.

siteCode.description: Uppercase alphanumeric code, unique across the service.

status.description: The lifecycle state shared by every structural aggregate. Decommission is one-way in v1. UnderMaintenance is a legal persisted state that the read models render; no v1 use case sets it.
status.title: Status

siteRole.description: The site's role in the fulfilment network (ADR-0037). `UNSPECIFIED` means nobody classified the site yet; it is the registration default and cannot be assigned by `PUT /sites/{siteCode}/role`.
siteRole.title: SiteRole

items.title: Site

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page.

schema.title: SitePage

400.description: Malformed input: a body that is not valid JSON, a location code that is not seven `[A-Z0-9]` segments, a missing required identifier, a query parameter outside its documented enum, an invalid `limit` / `cursor` or an undeclared query parameter on a paged collection, or a missing / malformed Idempotency-Key on a POST.

schema.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details. Every error response in this API uses this shape.

type.description: A URI identifying the error CATEGORY. It is an identifier, not a link — it does not need to resolve.

title.description: A fixed, human-readable summary of the error category.
title.example: Location type is not legal in this zone

status.description: The HTTP status code, duplicated in the body per RFC 7807.

detail.description: The specific message for this occurrence.
detail.example: location type violates a placement rule for this zone: Shelf is denied in zone WH1-STOR-FRZ by rule [RULE-FRZ-NO-SHELF: Deny Shelf where temperatureClass=Frozen]

instance.description: The request path that produced the error.

schema.title: Problem

value.title: Malformed location code
value.detail: location code must have exactly 7 hyphen-joined segments (site-area-zone-aisle-bay-level-position): got 4 segments in "WH1-STOR-AMB-A07"

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: This endpoint changes state and requires a caller-supplied Idempotency-Key header so a retried request is never applied twice.

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is invalid
value.detail: The Idempotency-Key header must be 1-128 printable ASCII characters (a client-generated UUID per logical submit).

value.title: limit must be an integer between 1 and 500
value.detail: limit must be an integer between 1 and 500

value.title: cursor is not a valid page token
the collection does not declare this query parameter
